name: CSI:MTSU Forensic Science Camp
org: Middle Tennessee State University, Forensic Institute for Research and Education
what_you_do: Learn forensic science for four days. You hear from working professionals, collect evidence, and solve a mock crime scene as a team. A panel of judges critiques your team's conclusions.
pay_detail: $300 per student. This covers activities, labs, lunch and snacks each day, and a t-shirt.
deadline_text: Not stated on the program page. Email the program for dates.
how_to_apply: The program page does not describe how to register. Email fire@mtsu.edu to ask about dates and sign-up.
notes: This is a day camp, so it does not include housing. The page also says a pre-law camp is being explored but is not confirmed.
